audit.why: 61.95% over 297 games. Pantheon 1-5, Swain's window at 6 (Ascension drain), Pantheon reclaims at first item with E baited, Swain again at two+ items (DoT-scaled drain). Content win[] matches packet; full sides were blanket 'Skill'.
Spikes accurate and unusually specific already: L2 all-in before fragments, his 6-window, the first-item reclaim keyed to his E cooldown, his two-item Blackfire/Liandry drain spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] claimed Shield Vault 'stuns him out of Ascension's channel' — Demonic Ascension is a transform, not a channel, and is not cancelled by CC; cooldowns field had no digits; dos/donts bodies were pasted trade lines.
audit.why: Kit: R Demonic Ascension flat 120s, indefinite while draining — no channel flag. E Nevermove 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s is the root his combo depends on and the thing that cancels Pantheon's own E channel. Q Death's Hand 7s down to 3s. Passive heal justifies the existing anti-heal line in report[8].

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: At 2 he has no root yet and no fragments banked — W the first step-up and burst before his heal exists.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: Post-Torch his Q hits every 7s down to 3s at max and stacks bolts — trade at 750 range only with his E root already spent.

edits.before: - Swain Demonic Ascension: matchup-defining — His drain mode — disengage and reset the fight when it starts. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Aegis Assault for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Demonic Ascension is a flat 120s — his drain mode; disengage when it starts and re-commit once it ends. - Nevermove cycles every 12s at rank 1: with it down his combo has no lock. - Budget your E (22s) to block the root, never chip.

edits.before: Grand Starfall online — your shoves become bot-lane invoices. The early lead must become the map now.
edits.after: Demonic Ascension plus a Nevermove root out-drains your burst — his window; bait the E before any commit.

edits.before: First item spike: the stun-spear rotation deletes squishies. Last call before scaling lanes wake.
edits.after: First item hands the all-in back — with his 12s E root down, Aegis eats the W and you kill through the drain.

edits.before: Late Pantheon is a starting pistol: R the flank, stun the carry, block the counter — and let the team finish what the spear started.
edits.after: Two items scale the drain past your burst: Blackfire-Liandry DoT plus Ascension wins any long fight — pick him before he ults or don't.

edits.before: With your first item and Mortal Will up you get the all-in back if his E is on cooldown: Aegis Assault eats his root/W, Shield Vault stuns him out of Ascension's channel, and you kill him before the drain heals him up. The key is forcing the fight on your terms with his E down — never when he's already ulting with fragments stacked.
edits.after: With your first item and Mortal Will up you get the all-in back if his E is on cooldown: Aegis Assault eats his root/W, Shield Vault stuns him before Demonflare lands, and you kill him before the drain heals him up. The key is forcing the fight on your terms with his E down — never when he's already ulting with fragments stacked.
